why_actual_beta_permits_kernel: Choose equal row point and equal current/next column arrays in the two lanes. lane_weight_mle then returns identical beta_j(u) at every u, not merely at sampled test points.

Both public validators permit this. For the derived API, the experiment uses fixed external weights and parent; it does not claim these exact weights arise from a particular honest D1 GKR transcript. Restricting derived GKR weights would require a separate proved structural property.

Sources h and -h have zero weighted virtual oracle for every beta, so the folding proof checks a true zero aggregate. Existing source commitments authenticate arbitrary leaves and do not by themselves assert source RS degree.
refuted_contract: For arbitrary allowed functional weights, scalar virtual proximity at many u implies a jointly-close low-degree representative for every committed source lane.

corrected_functional_contract.fixed_inputs: Authenticated source functions F_j on the common lifted RS domain; externally bound weight tables W_j; fixed original scalar claim c. All fixed before weighted-sumcheck randomness u.
corrected_functional_contract.coefficient_family: beta_j(u) = MLE(W_j)(u), including actual sparse-lift/current/next mapping.
corrected_functional_contract.equivalence: Polynomial tuples P and Q are equivalent when sum_j beta_j(u)*(P_j-Q_j) is the zero univariate polynomial for every relevant u. No requirement that each P_j=Q_j.
corrected_functional_contract.representative_basin: A tuple P fixed before u represents the source family if the scalar oracle sum_j beta_j(u)*F_j is R-close to sum_j beta_j(u)*P_j on the RS domain, for every relevant u or outside a separately bounded bad set. This allows cancelling arbitrary source noise and is weaker than joint lane proximity.
corrected_functional_contract.functional_well_definedness: Prove equivalence preserves the requested original functional L(P)=sum_boolean_b sum_j W_j(b)*coeff_b(P_j). At Boolean u=b, beta_j(b)=W_j(b); coefficient_b of the zero batched polynomial is precisely the corresponding summand. This requires the exact common lift/weight identity, not an independent alpha argument.
corrected_functional_contract.close_case: If such a fixed representative exists and R+(N-T)+D<=N, RS uniqueness forces every sufficiently close adaptive scalar candidate to its weighted batch. Weighted sumcheck residual discrepancy then supplies noInitialCandidate. Existing WeightedVirtualInitial proves the stronger joint-close sufficient case; scalar-basin generalization is direct.
corrected_functional_contract.far_case_missing: If no fixed functional-equivalence representative exists, bound the challenge paths for which an adaptive degree<D scalar candidate exists AND satisfies the weighted residual. This is a structured-family extraction/concentration statement modulo the functional kernel; no bound is proved by the cancellation example. Candidate tuples cannot be selected independently after u and treated as fixed sumcheck witnesses.
corrected_functional_contract.possible_alternative: Add a separately analyzed independent vector-oracle proximity test to establish joint proximity; this would be a versioned protocol change, not an interpretation of beta(u) as independent alpha.
